approval.rationale: Top-down granular wind crust with soft drift ripples and a dusting of grit, the old, thin snow of a high pass rather than fresh powder; as an overlay in noise patches over the cold grass it breaks up the Frostspine without covering it.
limitations: Three small debris clumps are discrete features and repeat every 4 m where the snow is continuous.
The ripples all run one diagonal, so a wide snow patch shows the tile direction from the landscape camera.
No sparkle or subsurface: the crust is a matte albedo.
